FN-5SPU336-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 404
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kelvin Lawrence
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/09/2024
House Bill 404 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Electronic Security Board
of Licensure by an undetermined amount dependent on any additional company applications and
qualifying agent fees collectd for business entities and branch offices, which are provided for in
this bill. Under current law, business application fees range from $450 to $1050 per application,
and the qualifying agent fees start at $50 per individual.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations for the Board to adopt rules to
implant this bill.
